verdict.rationale: Parahelp's Customer Agent works as a team member inside Intercom, Zendesk, Front, Plain, or Pylon, so it inherits those systems' channels. The Pylon changelog explicitly names email, live chat, and Slack. An API mode lets you run the agent "wherever you implement it," which implies a route to in-app, but nothing documents in-app as a supported channel. Missing for 10: any evidence of WhatsApp or social channels, explicit in-app channel support, native channel coverage independent of the ticketing system, and independent corroboration.
